course_summary:
ISEN 665 / SYEN 645 | Management of Engineering Systems | Spring 2026
Instructor: Michael Graul | mgraul@tamu.edu
Meets: N/A | Online
Grading: Quizzes [20%], Homework [20%], Midterm exam [30%], Project Work [30%] — A: {100 ≥ x ≥ 90}, B: {90 > x ≥ 80}, C: {80 > x ≥ 70}, D: {70 > x ≥ 60}, F: {60 > x}
Topics: IDEF0 modeling, SysML, MBSE (system synthetic), Systems Dynamics Modeling, MFLT-Simulators for EM proficiency, Bias and Noise, Managerial Cybernetics, Organization System Design, CPM, PERT, CCPM, Agile, NARD, SEMP/Risk, STS, HRO, Earned Value Management, Critical Chain Project Management, Leadership, Management in engineering organizations, Systems engineering process, Project management, Planning, Forecasting (quantitative), Forecasting (qualitative), Financial analysis, Leadership styles, Motivation, Teamwork, Managing creative people, Navigating informal networks, Science and technology policy, Economic implications of engineering and technology, Complex system efforts, System lifecycle, Technologically based systems, Socio-technical systems, Production systems, Large system definition, Implementation, Execution, Sustainment, Prescriptive methods, Descriptive methods, Models, Conceptualizations, Technical communication, Management functions (leading, organizing, controlling), Contemporary support tools and practices, Life-cycle management of engineered systems, Modern planning techniques, Organizational techniques, Management control techniques, Decision making techniques, Life-cycle of technology programs, Manage multi-role teams, Communicate project status information, Establish a cogent technical argument, Problem definition, Needs analysis, Requirements definition for a complex engineering system problem, Engineering systems management, Engineering management corpus, Management of a technology or production system effort, R&D management, Production and service System management, AI-Basics, AI-Enabled Management, Labor relations, Project management controls, Ethics
Tools: Zoom, Canvas, Turnitin, AI technology, AI-bot, AI-Chatbot
Prerequisites: Graduate classification
